<!-- pr-reviewer: 3b722b0f7565f72f7c15d9e6b4343bc12f54ccfe -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (stacked on #674; reviewed only the commit beyond 3b45e3fe, with #674 as its base).

**What looks good**
- Kerf offset side is right: `kerf_ring` (crates/motion/src/plasma/ring.rs) grows an outer by r and shrinks a hole by r. A hole smaller than the kerf, a hole that narrows to a gap, and an outer slot narrower than the kerf are each refused by name with the contour label, instead of producing an offset that would cut the part.
- Leads are checked against the part (forbidden regions plus `cut.contains`, emit.rs). Inner-first order is built from the nesting tree (nest.rs). Open runs are cut on the centre line, and a note says so.
- CL contract is documented in CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md and implemented in `cl/torch.rs`. The golden `plasma_plate_with_holes.cl` is pinned in golden_cl.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new non-test code. New files are all under 400 lines (largest: emit.rs, 327).
- Undoable command and project round-trip are covered. Decision file `docs/decisions/670-plasma-profile.md` is present. Body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #670`. No CHANGELOG.md or snapshot PNG edits. No build.rs, scripts, .github or Cargo changes.

**Local results** (merged with upstream/main, which was already up to date; clippy ran on the same tree)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| plasma_profile | 7 passed |
| plasma_machine | 6 passed |
| golden_cl | 24 passed |
| project_roundtrip | 69 passed |
| commands_undo | 32 passed |
| machine | 32 passed |
| camcraft-cl | 33 passed |
| camcraft-motion `plasma` tests | 11 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The decision file's item 12 lists what is not judged yet: material left by a slot narrower than the kerf on an outer contour that the offset bridges without enclosing. #672 is named as the owner.
- This PR contains #674's commits. Merge #674 first, or retarget, as the stacking rules say.
- I did not run the UI suites or hand-check the CL/post path on a real machine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: aad9b386053d47ded773a3536ecc57c6ac874beb -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The refreshed merge resolution is right. `posting.rs::posted_rpm` now returns 0 for `Probe | Torch`, so the torch's rpm-0 rule lives in main's single answer. `torch_tool` carries `orientation: None`. The `ThreadHand` and torch exports in `cl/mod.rs` coexist.
- The torch refusals are by name (`Tool::torch_refusal`). The plasma ops are gated both ways by machine kind, and `PlasmaProfile` is appended at stored id 39.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` was added in non-test source. No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or Cargo changes. No snapshot PNGs, no `CHANGELOG.md` or `RECOMMENDED.md` edits. The decision file is `docs/decisions/670-plasma-profile.md`. New modules carry provenance, and every new file is under 400 lines.
- The PR carries #674's commits, so it builds and tests on main alone. The trial merge with `upstream/main` was clean.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, debug)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-motion lib `plasma` | 11 pass |
| camcraft-motion `one_descent` | 3 pass |
| camcraft-cl, camcraft-tools | all pass |
| camcraft-app lib | 103 pass |
| app `plasma_profile` | 7 pass |
| app `plasma_machine` | 6 pass |
| app `golden_cl` | 24 pass |
| app `tool_law` | 4 pass |
| app `posting` | 17 pass |
| app `tormach_safe_retract` | 4 pass |
| app `machine` | 32 pass |
| app `machine_edit` | 12 pass |
| app `machine_library` | 11 pass |
| app `ribbon` | 11 pass |
| app `probe_op` | 12 pass |
| camcraft-ui lib (CWD `crates/ui`) | 425 pass, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-D warnings` on tools, cl, motion, post, sim, ui (all targets) and app (lib plus the suites above) | clean |

Not run: sim and post test binaries, and the remaining app test binaries. `crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs` does not compile on main (#686; missing `hand` in `OpParams`), so it was excluded. That is not caused by this PR.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The mill-turn now admits only milling and turning. The PR body flags this as a behaviour change.
- As the PR says, #671's post must refuse a Plasma Profile path that has no plasma record.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
